result:
Perfect! All tests pass now. 

**The bug:** The merging condition in the `insert` method was `s.start < last.end`, which only merges overlapping spans but not touching ones.

**The fix:** Changed the condition to `s.start <= last.end` (line 54 in src/lib.rs) to also merge spans that are adjacent (where one ends exactly where the next begins).

This allows the test case with spans [1,4) and [4,6) to correctly merge into [1,6).
